description: This file contains the PHP class 'Customer' which is part of the OpenCart admin model extension for reports related to customers. The class provides methods for retrieving various customer statistics such as total customers by day, week, month, year, as well as fetching customer details and order summaries.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: A model class that offers methods to generate various customer-related reports and statistics in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByDay
methods.description: Returns an array with hourly total customer counts for the current day.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByWeek
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts per day for the current week.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByMonth
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts per day for the current month.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByYear
methods.description: Returns an array with total customer counts per month for the current year.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches customer data with optional filters such as date range, customer name, or status.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers, optionally grouped by day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns a list of orders with customer info and aggregated product and total order amounts, supporting filters.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders within optional date filters.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Fetches reward points data for customers, including total points, order count, and total spent, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getTotalRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers with reward points, optionally filtered by date, customer, etc.

methods.name: getCustomerActivities
methods.description: Retrieves customer activity logs, such as key actions, data, IPs, and timestamps, with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerActivities
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer activity records, with support for filters.

methods.name: getCustomerSearches
methods.description: Retrieves customer search keyword data, including search terms, categories, products, IPs, and timestamps, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerSearches
methods.description: Returns total count of customer search records, optionally filtered by date range, keyword, customer, etc.
